edges.mechanism: A 25bp cut lowers the policy rate, so short Treasury yields should fall at or right after the decision. Evidence shows the cut is contested (hike-leaning dots and futures), which affects whether the cut happens, not how it transmits if it does.

evidence.supports: Sept dot plot: 16 of 18 participants expected at least one more hike, which argues against a cut at this meeting
evidence.rebuttal: This bears on the probability that the cut happens, not on whether a cut would lower short yields. The chain is conditional on the cut.

evidence.supports: Futures prices imply an 85 percent chance of at least one hike by year-end, which argues against an October cut
evidence.rebuttal: Futures odds measure the likelihood of the event, not the transmission of a cut once it occurs. The chain is conditional on the cut.

evidence.supports: The September projections show a large majority expect it will be appropriate to raise rates, which argues against a cut
evidence.rebuttal: This is evidence about the event's likelihood and the committee's direction, not about how a cut would move short yields. The chain is conditional on the cut.

edges.mechanism: Lower expected policy rates pull the long end down through the expectations path. The contested premise is whether term premium offsets this, which is the branch split.

evidence.supports: In a May 2025 episode, longer-term yields rose partly because of higher term premiums while short yields fell
evidence.rebuttal: This is one 2025 episode in which term premium lifted long yields. It is the risk the term-premium branch captures, not a refutation that expected cuts lower the long end in the base case.

evidence.supports: If inflation stays above target, households and businesses may eventually stop believing inflation will return to 2 percent
evidence.rebuttal: This is a conditional warning about de-anchoring if inflation stays high. It is the premise of the term-premium branch, not evidence about current long yields.

edges.mechanism: Persistent above-target inflation raises the inflation risk premium that investors demand for holding long bonds, so long yields can rise even as the policy rate falls. The pack has no excerpt directly linking these, so the edge is a model hypothesis.

A cut that markets read as premature, given inflation above target, can raise term premium as investors demand compensation for policy-credibility risk. The pack has no excerpt directly linking these, so the edge is a model hypothesis.
Falling long-end yields raise the price of long-duration Treasuries, so TLT rallies. Stable long-run inflation expectations mean the cut is not offset by an inflation premium at the long end.

evidence.supports: Most measures of longer-term inflation expectations have stayed stable at levels consistent with 2 percent inflation, so the long end is not pricing an inflation premium that would block a yield decline

edges.mechanism: A rising term premium lifts long yields and lowers TLT's price, so the cut produces a bear steepening that hurts long-duration bonds. The pack has no excerpt directly linking these, so the edge is a model hypothesis.

conditions.rule: met if the 2026-10-28 FOMC statement lowers the target range by 25bp; not_met if the range is held or moved by a different amount

conditions.threshold_note: 2% is the Fed's stated target; the September 2026 CPI print was 3.7% y/y, so the assumption is checked against the latest print before 2026-10-28
conditions.rule: met if the latest 12-month CPI-U change published before 2026-10-28 is above 2.0%; not_met otherwise

conditions.threshold_note: The pack gives no short Treasury yield series or size of the move; the user must confirm which policy-sensitive yield to track and how far it should fall. No series chosen here.
conditions.rule: met if a policy-sensitive short Treasury yield on 2026-11-04 is at or below its 2026-10-27 close; not_met otherwise

conditions.threshold_note: The pack gives no long-end yield series or threshold; the user must confirm the benchmark (for example the 10-year or 20-year Treasury yield) and the minimum move. No series chosen here.
conditions.rule: met if the chosen long-end Treasury yield on 2026-11-04 is below its 2026-10-27 close; not_met otherwise

conditions.threshold_note: The pack has no term-premium estimate or threshold; the user or a data source must confirm the measure and the minimum rise. No series chosen here.
conditions.rule: met if the long-end Treasury yield on 2026-11-04 is above its 2026-10-27 close while short yields fall over the same window; not_met otherwise
